text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Inference service latency spike detected for /v1/generate (region: us-west). Auto-page: #oncall. PID: 29a7.

Alice M.: saw the page. looks like tail latency jumped ~6x at 12:14. customers seeing timeouts.

Bob K.: getting a handful of 504s too. retries are making it worse. service queue depth spiked.

Charlie (oncall): I'm on it, joining from mobile. any error logs yet?

Dana SRE: checking logs now. heads up: we changed fluentd sampling last night for cost. might be missing some trace-level logs.

Eli (eng-ml): rollback plan prepared for model-variant v2 -> v1 if needed. but want to confirm root cause.

Alice M.: quick customer impact note: Payment checkout flows affected for ~12% of traffic to hosted-api-prod over last 10min. alerting ops and support.

Bob K.: digging into metrics: CPU okay, GPU utilization spiky but within expected. KVS (redis) latency shows a tail increase coincident with spike.

Charlie (oncall): can someone paste the kusto/log query you ran? I don't have a laptop yet.

Alice M.: paste: 
``` 
FROM logs
| where service == "inference" and route == "/v1/generate"
| where timestamp >= ago(15m)
| summarize p95_latency = percentile(latency_ms,95) by bin(timestamp,1m)
```

Dana SRE: looking at the pipeline: there is a 12:12 -> 12:18 window where our fast-sampling agent switched to 1% sampling (was 10%). I can see gaps in trace IDs. that's probably why we have fewer spans in traces.

Eli (eng-ml): that sampling change could hide request-level errors. but the latency itself is in metrics (not traces). hypothesis: degraded cache hit rate -> more model loads -> higher KV fetch latency.

Bob K.: running an ad-hoc query on redis latency logs: 
```
redis_latency_ms | where timestamp between (datetime(2024-06-28T12:00:00Z), datetime(2024-06-28T12:30:00Z))
| extend tail = percentile(latency_ms, 99)
| where tail > 100
```
Result: spike starting at 12:13, peaking 12:15, then partial recovery 12:20.

Charlie (oncall): ok, mitigation suggestions?

Dana SRE: immediate: revert sampling to 10% to recover trace coverage (won't reduce latency but helps diagnosis). also temp increase logging level on inference-forwarder to DEBUG for 10min.

Alice M.: operational mitigation: enable fallback route to model-variant v1 for 10% of traffic (canary) to avoid full rollout. Eli can you stage that?

Eli (eng-ml): staging canary now. applying traffic-split: v2 90% -> v1 10% for /v1/generate.

incident-bot: deploy started by Eli (eng-ml). See /deploys/1742101234.

Bob K.: also started a manual cache warm for the heavy prompt templates to avoid cold loads.

Charlie (oncall): handoff note — I'm taking this to mitigation and timeline. Alice, can you keep customer comms updated?

Alice M.: will do. posting status to status.redwood.ai: "Partial timeouts on /v1/generate influencing some payment flows. Mitigations in progress: canary v1, increased logging. No data loss."

Dana SRE: reverted sampling to 10% at ~12:24 (config change id cfg-993). forwarder debug logs enabled at 12:25.

Bob K.: after canary applied latency p95 for v1 is ~180ms, for v2 ~420ms. overall p95 back down to ~260ms by 12:28.

Eli (eng-ml): rolling rollback to v1 for 50% if we keep seeing >300ms for v2. preferring partial rollback rather than full.

Charlie (oncall): good. starting in-incident RCA thread: we need timeline, logs, hypotheses, and observability gaps. I'll capture notes here.

Charlie (oncall): TIMELINE (initial):
- 12:12 config: sampling agent update deployed (by infra team) -> sampling reduced to 1%
- 12:13 latency spike begins (p95 jump)
- 12:14 incident-bot auto-page
- 12:15 redis tail latency spike observed
- 12:24 sampling revert -> 10%
- 12:25 forwarder debug enabled
- 12:28 canary v1 applied 10%
- 12:32 partial recovery observed

Alice M.: I'm pasting the key log excerpt we have (some lines redacted):
```
[12:14:03] inference_worker.go: processing request id=abc123 route=/v1/generate latency_ms=412 queue_depth=18
[12:14:03] redis_client.go: GET cache_key=prompt_hash err=null latency_ms=128
[12:14:04] model_loader.go: load_model shard=3 duration_ms=210
[12:14:06] inference_worker.go: request id=abc124 route=/v1/generate latency_ms=950 err=timeout
```

Eli (eng-ml): that log suggests cache miss cascades -> model reload -> long tail. want to see more of redis logs around 12:13-12:16.

Dana SRE: problem: due to sampling change, many redis-client debug logs were not collected between 12:12-12:24. we only have aggregated metrics, not per-request traces.

Bob K.: added hypothesis tracker: 
H1: sampling change removed visibility, but not root cause.
H2: Redis cluster experienced a GC/backpressure causing tail latency.
H3: Autoscaler mis-schedule caused temporary overload on a subset of hosts.
H4: Model-variant v2 has heavier cold-starts leading to tail.

Charlie (oncall): evidence we need per-hosti redis slowlog and forwarder logs. Dana, can you request those from logging retention (raw store)?

Dana SRE: asked infra-logs team for raw archives at 12:36. ETA 20m. note: retention policy set to 7d but some indexes were rotated early due to disk pressure — might be partial.

Alice M.: customer comms updated at 12:40: "Mitigation applied. We are monitoring. A subset of requests experienced elevated latency; retries may have caused additional load."

Eli (eng-ml): quick check: model load histogram shows increased loads at 12:13-12:17 from ~2/s to 12/s across a subset of hosts. correlates with cache miss hypothesis.

Bob K.: ran a quick dashboard correction: some dashboards were aggregating across both regions; masked the us-west spike. fixed query to filter region=us-west. note for postmortem.

Charlie (oncall): OBSERVABILITY GAPS (initial):
- Missing per-request logs between 12:12-12:24 due to sampling change.
- Slowlog rotation + disk pressure may have removed earliest raw logs.
- Dashboards aggregated regionally, masking localized incidents.
- No auto-playback to reconstruct missing traces.

Dana SRE: immediate action items: revert sampling config change to stable in CI, add alert on fast-sampling deployments, add sticky config to prevent midnight sampling jobs.

Eli (eng-ml): infra action: add a short-term metric for cache-miss-rate per host to detect localized cache storms.

Bob K.: put a dashboard delta alert: if p95 across hosts deviates >2x median host p95 -> page SRE.

Charlie (oncall): handoff plan: I'm on-call for another 20min then will hand to Dana. leaving these items: request raw slowlogs (Dana), redeploy sampling guard (Alice/Dana), evaluate partial rollback for v2 if tail persists (Eli).

Dana SRE: ack — will take after Charlie steps off.

Alice M.: closing note for this thread: please paste any recovered raw logs here when infra-logs responds. also attach any adhoc queries you used (we'll include in postmortem).

incident-bot: Incident state: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Duration so far: 34 minutes.

Frank PM: thanks team. please include customer impact timeline and T-shirt sizing for postmortem. I'll kick the postmortem doc once we have raw logs.

Charlie (oncall): leaving now, handing to Dana. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Dana SRE: taking point. I'll create the postmortem skeleton and tag infra-logs. Expect updates here.

Alice M.: will finalize status page update once Dana posts raw-log links.

Bob K.: saved queries and dashboards changed, pushing to repo with tags: "inc/1742101234-observability-fix".

Eli (eng-ml): note: long-term we should pre-warm models for heavy templates and track cache miss heatmaps. adding to backlog.

Charlie (oncall): final: root cause unknown until raw logs arrive. primary suspects: cache-miss storm + reduced observability.

incident-bot: Incident closed to active paging. Follow-up: create postmortem with tag incident-1742101234 and assign to Dana SRE.
